title: Verdict
description: One gradient axis's answer about one subject, with the per-check witness backing it — the wire projection of the protocol verdict spine. Reach, epistemic standing, and downstream compute/trust + retention axes all narrow onto this one shape. `decision.type` is the three-valued spine discriminator (permit | refuse | refer); `refer` is the first-class ceiling marker (a routed question for a human/elohim at the named layer), never a fallthrough, timeout, or error. Source of truth: elohim/epr/src/verdict.rs (Verdict) — wire projection of the verdict spine (Operational, Category C — evaluated per request over notarized/witnessed inputs, never persisted). Spec: reach-ontology-vocabulary-split-spec §2a.

axis.description: The gradient axis id this verdict answers on (e.g. 'reach', 'epistemic').

subject.description: Opaque content reference the verdict is about — a CID string when content-addressed; null when the axis concerns an actor/context rather than a specific artifact.

decision.description: The spine answer. `permit`/`refuse` carry only `type`; `refer` additionally carries the routed question (layer + reason + note).

layer.description: For `refer`: the governance layer that should receive the question (subsidiarity routing).

reason.description: For `refer`: why it escalated — novel-situation | insufficient-authority | contested-evidence.

note.description: For `refer`: optional human-readable context for the receiving layer.

witness.description: Positive per-check evidence backing the decision (stronger than a violations-only report — a passed check with an observed value is positive proof the rule held).

checks.description: The per-check evidence, in evaluation order.

checkId.description: Stable id of the check that ran.

observed.description: The observed value the check recorded (any JSON value, or null) — the positive evidence.

policyRef.description: Reference to the policy/manifest binding that parameterized the check, when one applies.
